definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 defines method as 'A procedural entity defined by a method definition within, or inherited by, a class definition'; 2023 drops the entry and describes methods at §2023:9.3.4, whose text is word for word §2002:9.3.4. SR3's 'function, method, or program' names the same runtime elements in 2002, so the procedures governed are unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:9.3.5 (method resolution) and §2002:14.5.12.1.2, 14.5.12.1.3 and 14.5.12.2 (fatal and non-fatal handling, incompatible data; 2023 retitles 'Non-fatal' as 'Nonfatal' at 14.6.13.1.4 and adds the PERFORM WHEN arms). SR3 is a compile-time rule on which procedure-name RESUME AT may name and rests on none of that runtime text, so the 2002 refusals (COBOL0714) stand.
